pages.text: The canal was especially calm that day. A gentle breeze was blowing.
Pongi spread out some paper. "I'm going to make the boat that goes the farthest."
Dad brought the biggest sheet of paper. "A big boat will go far."
Pongi's little brother folded paper too. It made a very tiny boat.
Dad put the big boat on the water. It moved slowly forward.
But water came into the boat. The paper went limp.
The big boat tilted to one side. Then it slowly sank.
The little brother's boat went past. It was light and bobbed on the water.
The tiny boat passed beneath the bridge.
Pongi's little brother put another tiny boat on the water. All Dad had left in his hands was wet paper.
